root_cause.text: The function `intel_pstate_update_limits_for_all()` iterates over all possible CPUs using `for_each_possible_cpu()` and passes `all_cpu_data[cpu]` directly to `intel_pstate_update_max_freq()` without checking if the CPU is online or if the `all_cpu_data` entry is non-NULL, causing a NULL pointer dereference for offline CPUs.
root_cause.evidence: CVE description states: "This occurs because for_each_possible_cpu() returns CPUs even if they are not online. For those CPUs, all_cpu_data[] will be NULL. Since commit 973207ae3d7c ... all_cpu_data[] is dereferenced even for CPUs which are not online, causing the NULL pointer dereference." The patch changes `intel_pstate_update_max_freq` to take a CPU number instead of a `cpudata` pointer, and only accesses `all_cpu_data[cpu]` inside the function after verifying a cpufreq policy exists via `cpufreq_cpu_get(cpu)`.

The patch changes `intel_pstate_update_max_freq` to take a CPU number instead of a `cpudata` pointer, and only accesses `all_cpu_data[cpu]` inside the function after verifying a cpufreq policy exists via `cpufreq_cpu_get(cpu)`.

candidates.rationale: Iterates over all possible CPUs, including offline ones, without filtering for online CPUs, leading to NULL pointer dereference for offline CPUs.
Directly passes the result of all_cpu_data[cpu] to the function without checking for NULL, which can be NULL for offline CPUs.
Function definition that accepts a cpudata pointer without intrinsic NULL check, relying on callers to provide valid pointer.
Dereferences cpudata->cpu when cpudata is NULL, causing a NULL pointer dereference and crash.
This check occurs after the dereference of cpudata->cpu, so it does not prevent the crash when cpudata is NULL; the vulnerability lies in the missing early NULL check on cpudata.

vuln_statements.explanation: This line directly passes a potentially NULL pointer (from all_cpu_data[cpu] for offline CPUs) to the function, leading to NULL pointer dereference inside the function.
This loop iterates over all possible CPUs, including offline ones, without filtering. For offline CPUs, all_cpu_data[cpu] is NULL, causing the subsequent call to pass NULL.
This function definition does not include an intrinsic NULL check on the cpudata pointer, allowing a NULL pointer to be dereferenced inside the function.
This line dereferences cpudata->cpu without first checking if cpudata is NULL, directly causing a NULL pointer dereference when cpudata is NULL.
This check on policy occurs after the dereference of cpudata->cpu, so it does not prevent the crash when cpudata is NULL. It is part of the vulnerable code path.
